newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Illicit ivory haul seized at Tanzania airport.
newsitem.headline: Illicit ivory haul seized at Tanzania airport.

text.p: An illicit haul of 1,800 pieces of elephant ivory has been seized at Dar es Salaam international airport while bound for the Ethiopian capital Addis Ababa, a senior American diplomat said on Thursday.

The shipment, found on Wednesday, was packed in cases of fraudulent documents purporting to be from the U.S. embassy in Dar es Salaam, said Kiki Munshi, director of the United States Information Services in Tanzania.
The shipment bore the false endorsement of the Tanzanian foreign ministry and the shipping notice cited the U.S. embassy in Addis Ababa as the final destination of the cargo, Munshi told Reuters.

"Upon inspection the crates were found to contain a large amount of ivory. It is not yet known who is responsible for this illegal shipment. Appropriate Tanzanian authorities are investigating the matter," said Munshi.
"The U.S. government condemns this and all attempts to smuggle ivory and other products from animals from the endangered species list," she said.

The ivory comprised the equivalent of 300 elephant tusks and was discovered by staff who noticed the weight given on the invoice failed to match the actual weight of the crates. No value was placed on the haul.
